tagline:
Archive your dream today.
Break it into steps you can do.
script: *Later* isn't a time. || Nothing in your day says *later*. || So it *never* comes. || Give it a *trigger*. || After I ___, I *will* ___. || After my morning *coffee*: 10 Spanish flashcards. || After I close my *laptop*: a 20-minute walk. || After *dinner*: read 10 pages. || Pick *one* habit you keep skipping. || Write the sentence *tonight*. || Archive your dream *today*. || Break it into *small* steps. || I've put the link in the bio.
spoken: [hook] Later isn't a time. || When you say you'll do it later, there's nothing in your day that actually says later. || So it just never comes. || [turn] So give the habit a trigger instead, something you already do every single day. || And use this sentence. After I do this, I will do that. || Like, after I pour my morning coffee, I'll go through ten Spanish flashcards. || After I close my laptop for the day, I'll go for a twenty minute walk. || After I finish dinner, I'll read ten pages of my book. || [land] So pick the one habit you keep putting off, and attach it to something you already do. || [land] Then write that sentence down tonight. || [outro] That's what Dmyor is for. You archive your dream today, so you can see it tomorrow, || [outro] and break it down into small steps you can actually do. || [outro] If you want to try it out, I've put the link in the bio.
